newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma may consider draft budget from Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma may consider draft budget from Nov 20.

text.p: Russia's State Duma lower house will start considering a revised 1997 draft budget from November 20, Interfax news agency quoted Finance Minister Alexander Livshits as saying.
Parliament and government officials set up a conciliation commission after the Duma rejected the first draft.
Livshits said the commision's work was proving difficult.

"There is more politics and less and less constructive suggestions in deputies' speeches," he said. "I think the conciliation commission must finish its work quicker, otherwise it can drag on unreasonably."

The commission widened the budget deficit to 3.5 percent from the initial 3.3 percent and agreed to base the budget on an annual inflation rate of 11.8 percent, the higher of two scenarios originally proposed.
The panel also agreed on a forecast for GDP of 2,727 trillion roubles, implying real growth of two percent.
